==About==

A {{i|Charred Something}} was obtained when crafting {{i|Roasted Meat}} using {{i|Meat Shreds}} over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. The Healing and [[Gluttony]] Time, Amount, and Reduce of a Charred Something are completely random.
